# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      tidy.opts = list(width.cutoff = 60))
set.seed(123)
```

## Load packages
```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(PMCMRplus)
library(rstatix)
```

## Setup global plot theme
```{r}
th.small <-   theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=6, colour ="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=6, colour ="black"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=7, face="bold"),
        legend.position="none",
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))
```

## Set up color palettes 
```{r}
sp.palette.abb <- c("B. lata" = "#F781BF", 
             "B. profunda" = "#999999",
             "B. marlena" = "#984EA3",
             "B. pyrosa" = "#E41A1C",
             "B. stenotes" ="#ffca13",
             "B. amoena" = "#4DAF4a",
             "B. elongata" = "#377EB8",
             "B. gigas" = "#A65628",
             "B. sp." = "black")
```

## Load data
```{r, message = FALSE}
nem_dim_data <- read_xlsx("data/nematocysts_measurements.xlsx", sheet="final_measurements")
```

## Initial calculations (volume and dimensions)
```{r}
# calculate volume assuming that large haploneme and stenoteles are prolate spheroid and small haploneme is a sphere. This chunk includes sanity check for length>width for ellipsoids. 

nem_dim <- nem_dim_data %>%
  mutate(len.check = length >= width) %>%
  mutate(
    temp = ifelse(!len.check, width, length),
    width = ifelse(!len.check, length, width),
    length = temp) %>%
  select(-temp) %>%
  mutate(mean_dim = (length + width) / 2,
    volume = ifelse(
      `cell_type` == "small haplonemes",
      (4/3) * pi * ((mean_dim / 2)^3),        # sphere (mean radius)
      (4/3) * pi * (length/2) * ((width/2)^2) # prolate spheroid
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(volume_mm3 = volume/1e9)

# generate summaries for each nematocyst type
nem_sum <- nem_dim %>%
  group_by(species, cell_type) %>%
  summarize(N = n(),
    mean_length = round(mean(length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_length = round(sd(length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_width = round(mean(width, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_width = round(sd(width, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_volume = round(mean(volume, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_volume = round(sd(volume, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  rename('Species' = species,
         'Nematocyst type' = cell_type,
         'Mean length [µm]' = mean_length,
         'SD length [µm]' = sd_length,
         'Mean width [µm]' = mean_width,
         'SD width [µm]' = sd_width,
         'Mean volume [µm^-3]' = mean_volume,
         'SD volume [µm^-3]' = sd_volume,)

write.csv(nem_sum, "results/summary_cell_measurements.csv")
```

## Statistical tests
```{r}
# test data distribution
shapiro_results_nems <- nem_dim %>%
  group_by(species, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(volume)$p.value)

write.csv(shapiro_results_nems, "results/shapiro_nem_volume.csv")

# run Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn post-hoc between cell types
KW_nems <- nem_dim %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  kruskal_test(volume_mm3 ~ species)

write.csv(KW_nems, "results/KW_nem_volume.csv")

dunn_test_nems <- nem_dim %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dunn_test(volume_mm3 ~ species, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
    select(cell_type, group1, group2, statistic, p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rename('Species 1' = group1,
         'Species 2' = group2,
         'Z statistic' = statistic,
         'Adjusted p-value' = p.adj,
         'Nematocyst type' = cell_type)

write.csv(dunn_test_nems, "results/dunn_posthoc_nem_volume.csv")
```

## Plot nematocytes volume
```{r}
nem_dim_plot <- ggplot(nem_dim, aes(y=volume_mm3, x= species, color=species, fill = species))+
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.4, color = "black")+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA, color="black", outlier.size = NA, alpha = .2)+
  geom_jitter(size = 1, aes(color = species), alpha = .3, width = 0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=sp.palette.abb)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=sp.palette.abb)+
  th.small+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1, face = "italic"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))+
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free")+
  xlab("Species")+
  ylab(label = expression("Volume ["~"mm"^"-3"~"]"))

ggsave(filename = "results/plot_volume_per_nematocysts.pdf", plot = nem_dim_plot, device = "pdf",
       width = 18, height = 6 , units = "cm")
```
